landing.heroLead: Personalised yoga and diet programmes, daily activity tracking, and progress reporting — for wellness organisations and the people they care for.
landing.ctaHint: Adira is private software. Your organisation creates your account.

customers.title: For the people practising
customers.body: Your programme, your daily practice, and your progress in one place — in your own language, on the phone you already carry.

consultants.title: For consultants
consultants.body: See the customers assigned to you, build their programmes, and follow how they are actually doing between sessions.

organisations.title: For organisations
organisations.body: Your studio's people, roles, and records stay yours. Every record is scoped to your organisation by the database itself.

landing.statusBody: Adira is being built in phases and is not yet feature-complete. Authentication, multi-tenancy, and the database schema are live. Programmes, activity tracking, and reporting are still to come — this page will not claim otherwise before they exist.
